SELECT `id` as id, `name` as name FROM `module_types` WHERE `status` = 1
AND id IN (68,48,25,69)
AND `name` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT cus.id AS id, cus.user_app_id AS userAppId, cus.customer_code AS code, CONCAT(cus.name_kh, ' (', cus.name, ')') AS name, cus.recurrence AS recurrence, IFNULL(cus.photo, '') AS photo, cus.payment_term_id AS paymentTermId, payment_terms.name AS paymentTermName FROM customers AS cus LEFT JOIN payment_terms ON cus.payment_term_id = payment_terms.id WHERE cus.is_active = 1
AND cus.id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customer_cgroups WHERE cgroup_id = #{filter.organizationGroupId} GROUP BY customer_id)
AND cus.user_app_id IS NOT NULL
AND cus.id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM sale_target_employee_organizations WHERE is_active = 1 AND sale_target_employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM sale_target_employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = #{filter.employeeId}))
AND (cus.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR cus.name_kh LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR cus.customer_code LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR cus.main_number LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR cus.mobile_number LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR cus.other_number LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM membership_cards WHERE membership_cards.customer_id = cus.id AND membership_cards.is_active = 1 AND membership_cards.card_id LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") ) )
GROUP BY cus.id ORDER BY cus.id ASC
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT boqs.id as id, boqs.code as code, boqs.total_cost as totalCost, customers.id as organizationId, customers.name as organizationName, customer_contacts.id as organizationContactId, customer_contacts.contact_name as organizationContactName FROM boqs LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = boqs.customer_id LEFT JOIN customer_contacts ON customer_contacts.id = boqs.customer_contact_id WHERE boqs.status = 2
AND boqs.id NOT IN (SELECT boq_id FROM project_costings WHERE project_costings.status > 0 AND boq_id IS NOT NULL)
AND boqs.id IN (SELECT boq_id FROM project_costings WHERE project_costings.status = 2) AND boqs.id NOT IN (SELECT boq_id FROM boms WHERE boms.status > 0)
AND code LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
ORDER BY boqs.id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT boq_details.type_id AS `type`, boq_details.boq_id AS boqId, boq_details.id AS id, boq_details.description AS itemName, boq_details.product_id AS productId, p.code AS sku, p.barcode AS upc, p.name AS productName, (p.small_val_uom / IFNULL(boq_details.conversion,1)) AS conversion, boq_details.qty AS qty, boq_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, u.name AS uomName, boq_details.unit_cost AS unitCost, boq_details.total_cost AS totalCost, boq_details.unit_price AS unitPrice, boq_details.total_price AS totalPrice, boq_details.remark AS note FROM boq_details LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = boq_details.product_id LEFT JOIN uoms u ON u.id = boq_details.qty_uom_id WHERE boq_details.boq_id = #{boqId} ORDER BY boq_details.id ASC
SELECT id as id, name as name, symbol as symbol FROM `project_costing_term_details` WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND project_costing_term_id = #{id}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT YEAR(quotations.quotation_date) AS `year` FROM quotations WHERE quotations.status > 0 GROUP BY YEAR(quotations.quotation_date)
UNION ALL
SELECT YEAR(sales_orders.order_date) AS `year` FROM sales_orders WHERE sales_orders.status > 0 GROUP BY YEAR(sales_orders.order_date)
UNION ALL
SELECT YEAR(credit_memos.order_date) AS `year` FROM credit_memos WHERE credit_memos.status > 0 GROUP BY YEAR(credit_memos.order_date) ) AS combined GROUP BY `year`
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}
